verdict.rationale: Yubico's official ykman CLI provides full scriptable device management: enabling applications, setting PINs, configuring PIV/OATH/OTP slots, and reading device info. The docs present it as an equivalent alternative to the Yubico Authenticator GUI for tasks such as firmware checks. Official SDKs (.NET, Android, iOS, python-fido2) and the YubiEnterprise REST API extend programmatic control to app integration and fleet management. Missing for 10: an explicit first-party statement or feature matrix confirming GUI-to-CLI/API parity, independent hands-on corroboration of parity, and a machine-readable spec (no OpenAPI) for the fleet REST API.
